读法：
1. T→0 等价贪心，确定但容易重复；T 过大则胡言乱语；
2. top-p=0.9 通常保留 3~6 个候选，兼顾多样性与可控性；
3. 生产上常组合使用（T=0.7, top-p=0.9），并对结构化输出改用 constrained decoding；
4. 熵是监控采样健康度的好指标：突然降到 0 说明模型在死循环复读。
code:
# 同一组 logits，观察温度与核采样的概率分布、熵与候选集大小。
import numpy as np

logits = np.array([3.0, 2.5, 2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.0, -0.5, -1.0, -2.0])
tokens = [f"t{i}" for i in range(len(logits))]

def softmax(z):
    z = z - z.max()
    e = np.exp(z)
    return e / e.sum()

def entropy(p):
    return -(p * np.log(p + 1e-12)).sum()

def top_p_filter(p, top_p):
    order = np.argsort(-p)
    csum = np.cumsum(p[order])
    keep = order[:np.searchsorted(csum, top_p) + 1]
    q = np.zeros_like(p)
    q[keep] = p[keep] / p[keep].sum()
    return q, keep

print("原始 logits：" + " ".join(f"{t}={v:+.1f}" for t, v in zip(tokens, logits)))
print(f"\n{'温度':>5}{'熵':>8}{'top1 概率':>11}{'top-p=0.9 核大小':>17}{'核内质量':>10}")
for temp in (0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0):
    p = softmax(logits / temp)
    q, keep = top_p_filter(p, 0.9)
    print(f"{temp:>5}{entropy(p):>8.3f}{p.max():>11.3f}{len(keep):>17}{p[keep].sum():>10.3f}")

print(f"\n固定温度 1.0，只改 top-p：")
print(f"{'top-p':>7}{'核大小':>8}{'截断后熵':>10}{'被丢掉的质量':>13}{'保留的 token':>22}")
p = softmax(logits)
for tp in (0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0):
    q, keep = top_p_filter(p, tp)
    names = ",".join(tokens[i] for i in sorted(keep))
    print(f"{tp:>7}{len(keep):>8}{entropy(q):>10.3f}{1-p[keep].sum():>13.4f}{names:>22}")

# 实际采样：固定随机数，看不同策略的输出多样性
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
print("\n每种策略采样 10 次（种子固定）：")
for label, temp, tp in (("贪心", 0.0, 1.0), ("T=0.7", 0.7, 1.0),
                        ("T=1.0 + top-p 0.9", 1.0, 0.9), ("T=1.5", 1.5, 1.0)):
    if temp == 0:
        picks = [tokens[int(np.argmax(logits))]] * 10
    else:
        q, _ = top_p_filter(softmax(logits / temp), tp)
        picks = list(rng.choice(tokens, size=10, p=q))
    print(f"  {label:<20}" + " ".join(picks))

print("\n结论：temperature 只改变分布的平坦程度，长尾仍在；top-p 直接把尾部截掉再归一化。")
print("读法：")
print("1. T→0 等价贪心，确定但容易重复；T 过大则胡言乱语；")
print("2. top-p=0.9 通常保留 3~6 个候选，兼顾多样性与可控性；")
print("3. 生产上常组合使用（T=0.7, top-p=0.9），并对结构化输出改用 constrained decoding；")
print("4. 熵是监控采样健康度的好指标：突然降到 0 说明模型在死循环复读。")
